Understand a term

Saved explanations from this report, with their sources, questions and places on the map.

B-tree (via model)

A tree-shaped data structure that keeps entries ordered by key so they can be looked up, inserted, and iterated efficiently; here the keys are byte slices and each entry also carries a value and an expiration time.

BitmapRedisReplicator (via model) · database/in_memory_storage/bitmap/bitmam_redis_replicator.go:14:6

BitmapRedisReplicator copies bitmap set data to and from a Redis-backed dump, identified by a replication key and a storage name. Replicate writes the storage with a time-to-live, Recover reads it back, and DropReplicationKey removes the replication key.

Clickhouse (via model) · database/clickhouse/clickhouse.go:19:6

Clickhouse holds the connection settings for a ClickHouse database: host, port, username, password, database name, dial timeout, and connection pool limits. Each field carries an envconfig and mapstructure alias, so values can be supplied from environment variables or decoded configuration.

Configs (via model) · database/postgres/postgres.go:12:6

Configs holds PostgreSQL connection settings: host, port, username, password, database, SSL mode, application name, pool size, and various connection, health-check, and timeout durations. These fields configure how the database connection is established and maintained.

Cron (via model) · scheduler/cron.go:11:6

Cron wraps a cron scheduler and lets jobs be added by calendar expression. Add registers a function to run on the given calendar schedule, and Start and Stop control the underlying cron.

GRPCGatewayConfigs (via model) · server/grpc_gateway.go:40:6

GRPCGatewayConfigs holds settings for a gRPC gateway HTTP server, including the HTTP address, gRPC endpoint, network, read/write/idle/shutdown timeouts, max header bytes, and Swagger configuration. These fields configure how the gateway serves HTTP and connects to the gRPC backend.

GRPCGatewayServer (via model) · server/grpc_gateway.go:61:6

GRPCGatewayServer runs an HTTP server that proxies to a gRPC backend using its configs. Start registers the gateway with dial and mux options and returns a shutdown function, while shutdown stops the HTTP server.

HTTPServer holds a port, a Gorilla mux router, and a logger for serving HTTP. RunHTTPServer starts the server with a handler and middleware and returns a shutdown function, while ToConfigureHandlers applies a configuration callback.

JobSchedulerInterface (via model) · scheduler/contract.go:7:6

JobSchedulerInterface is the contract for a scheduler that accepts job configurations and can be started and stopped. Add registers a job, while Start and Stop each return a function, indicating they hand back a cleanup or control callback.

LeaderElectingWatchdog (via model) · watchdog/contract.go:3:6

LeaderElectingWatchdog is the contract for a watchdog that elects a leader and can be stopped. Elect takes a configuration and returns a channel of integers, and Stop halts the watchdog.

watchdog/contract.go:3:6
Locker (via model) · locker/contract.go:14:2

Locker is the contract for acquiring, releasing, and extending a named lock identified by a key and value. Lock and ExtendLockTTL take an expiration duration, and Unlock releases the lock for the given key and value.

On the map

  • Explore github.com/PavelAgarkov/service-pkg / Distributed locking →

locker/contract.go:14:2
ReadinessBarrierInterface (via model) · readiness_barrier/contract.go:5:6

ReadinessBarrierInterface is the contract for a readiness barrier that can be started and stopped and reports whether it is ready. SendSignalCtx delivers a toggle signal, and IsReady reports the current readiness state.

readiness_barrier/contract.go:5:6
RedisWatchdogLeader (via model) · watchdog/watchdog_leader.go:30:6

RedisWatchdogLeader performs leader election using a locker, running under a context with cancellation. Elect takes a configuration and returns a channel of integers, and Stop cancels the context to halt election.

TTL (via model)

Time to live: a duration after which an entry is considered expired, so it can be purged or listed as expired at a given time.

Files in which this term appears · 7 files
bitmap (via model)

A compact data representation that tracks set membership per bit; here bitmap set data can be copied to and from a Redis-backed dump or held in memory as byte slices.

Files in which this term appears · 5 files
distributed locking (via model)

A coordination mechanism that lets separate processes or instances share a lock so only one of them performs a given action at a time.

leader election (via model)

Choosing one participant among several to act as the leader, typically by competing through a locker under a cancellable context.

rate limiting (via model)

Restricting how often requests or operations are allowed to occur, usually to protect a service from being overwhelmed.

scheduling (via model)

Arranging work, such as periodic jobs, to run at planned times or intervals.
